attributes.headline: Clear the set. Keep the proof.
attributes.subhead: A narrow software-factory trial that turns one live set into a governed cue sheet through mechanical extraction, AI rights analysis, human approval, and an auditable release decision.

cardInfo.name: Factory Trial 03 — CueClear
cardInfo.summary: A 5-reuse / 10-build factory proposal for one culturally current music-clearance workflow with extraction, AI, human approval, and audit.
cardInfo.notes: Proposal authored 2026-07-21. The five reuse cards are candidates until their live CardDefs pass the proposal's reuse gate. Realm-server capabilities are explicitly excluded from the artifact budget.
